description: This Java test class 'SudoIT' contains integration tests for the 'read' persistence layer of the 'thingsearch' service within Eclipse Ditto. It focuses on testing 'sudo' operations such as counting and streaming metadata related to 'things', as well as generating namespace reports. The file extends a base test class, sets up test data, and defines multiple test cases verifying functionality with different queries.

classes.name: SudoIT
classes.description: Integration test class for testing 'sudo' operations in the 'thingsearch' persistence layer.
